question: Which state won the Indian Olympic Association's 'Best State' award at the 36th National Games in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Maharashtra** won the Indian Olympic Association's** 'Best State' award **at the **36th National Games **in 2022.
 
• Maharashtra won a total of **256 medals,** including **102 gold, 78 silver, and 76 bronze medals.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The 36th National Games of India was the** 36th edition** of the National Games of India.
 
• It took place in **Gujarat state** from **September 29 to October 12, 2022**, in the cities of Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot, and Bhavnagar.
 
• **Uttar Pradesh** finished **second** in the medal tally at the 36th National Games, winning a total of **164 medals**, including 43 gold, 44 silver, and 77 bronze medals.
 
• **Punjab** finished** third **in the medal tally at the 36th National Games, winning a total of **151 medals,** including 41 gold, 50 silver, and 60 bronze medals.
 
• **Haryana** finished fourth in the medal tally at the 36th National Games, winning a total of **117 medals**, including 36 gold, 33 silver, and 48 bronze medals.
